dedupe_keys.name: timeseries data of a drive cycle aging test of 28 high energy nca c si round cells of type 18650

description: RWTH Aachen provides time-series measurements of current, voltage, temperature and time for twenty-eight high-energy NCA/carbon-silicon 18650 cells. All cells experience the same room-temperature ageing condition and profile, but are cycled individually. Charging uses a constant-current/constant-voltage regime and discharge uses a recorded driving profile. Reference check-ups occur every thirty cycles. The source states an equivalent RWTH deposit DOI. Simulation uses: the EVERLASTING parent collection establishes calibration inputs for predicting electric-vehicle battery behaviour, lifetime and range. Coverage: exact measurement periods remain unstated. Access: public native metadata describes the release and stated formats. Licence: CC-BY-4.0. Current file access and cost remain unknown. Caveats: The native geolocation is Aachen, Germany. Exact dates, sampling interval and current measurement accuracy are unstated. The alternate DOI is source-declared equivalence, with no independent byte comparison.
